# Fuzz targets (WP-28, ADR-0035): COFF reader, PE reader, PDB reader, IPC deserialiser, control-pipe JSON codec.
#
#   cml_fuzz_<target>   one executable per target, exporting LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput (fuzz_<target>.cpp)
#   corpus/<target>/    checked-in seed corpus (small; generated by gen_seeds.cpp or reproducers of fixed bugs)
#
# Two build modes:
#
#   default            replay executables: replay_main.cpp supplies main() and runs every file of the corpus once. Each is a
#                      ctest, `fuzz.replay.<target>`, so every CI cell exercises the fuzz entry points and the seeds
#                      (including the reproducer of every bug a fuzzer ever found) on both compilers.
#   -DCML_FUZZ=ON      libFuzzer + AddressSanitizer binaries; clang-cl only. The readers under test are instrumented too, so
#                      build ONLY the cml_fuzz_* targets in such a tree (the unit tests and the agent are not meant to link
#                      with it). `fuzz.replay.<target>` then runs the libFuzzer binary with -runs=0 over the corpus.
#                      .github/workflows/fuzz.yml uses this: RelWithDebInfo, 10 minutes per target.
#
# AddressSanitizer on Windows comes in two shapes: the static runtime (clang_rt.asan-x86_64.lib, older LLVM installers) and,
# since LLVM 19, a static thunk in front of the runtime DLL (clang_rt.asan_static_runtime_thunk-x86_64.lib +
# clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.lib/.dll; the LLVM 20.1.8 of the windows-2022 image has only this one). Both work with the
# project's static CRT (/MT); libFuzzer is built for it, so /MD is no option. The DLL is copied next to the executables.

option(CML_FUZZ "Build the fuzz targets as libFuzzer + ASan binaries (clang-cl only; see tests/fuzz/CMakeLists.txt)" OFF)

set(CML_FUZZ_TARGETS coff pe pdb ipc control)
set(CML_FUZZ_LIBS_coff cml_coff cml_util)
set(CML_FUZZ_LIBS_pe cml_pe cml_util)
set(CML_FUZZ_LIBS_pdb cml_pdb cml_pe cml_util)
set(CML_FUZZ_LIBS_ipc cml_ipc cml_proc cml_util)
set(CML_FUZZ_LIBS_control cml_ipc cml_proc cml_util)
# Every library that is linked into a fuzz target (they are instrumented in CML_FUZZ mode).
set(CML_FUZZ_INSTRUMENTED cml_util cml_coff cml_pe cml_pdb cml_ipc cml_proc cml_third_party_raw_pdb)

set(_cml_fuzz_san_flags "")
set(_cml_fuzz_link_libs "")
set(_cml_fuzz_link_opts "")
set(_cml_fuzz_asan_dll "")
if(CML_FUZZ)
    if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "CML_FUZZ needs clang-cl (libFuzzer + AddressSanitizer on Windows); this compiler is ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID}")
    endif()
    if(MSVC)
        # The CMake link step calls the linker directly, so the runtimes the clang-cl driver would add are named here, as
        # clang's MSVC toolchain passes them: whole-archive fuzzer; for ASan either whole-archive asan + asan_cxx (static
        # CRT) or asan_dynamic + whole-archive asan_dynamic_runtime_thunk + /include:__asan_seh_interceptor (dynamic CRT).
        execute_process(COMMAND "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" /clang:-print-resource-dir
                        OUTPUT_VARIABLE _cml_resource_dir OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE RESULT_VARIABLE _cml_rc)
        if(NOT _cml_rc EQUAL 0 OR NOT _cml_resource_dir)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "CML_FUZZ: cannot ask ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER} for its resource directory")
        endif()
        file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${_cml_resource_dir}" _cml_resource_dir)
        set(_cml_rt "${_cml_resource_dir}/lib/windows")
        file(GLOB _cml_rt_found "${_cml_rt}/*.lib" "${_cml_rt}/*.dll")
        message(STATUS "CML_FUZZ: runtimes in ${_cml_rt}: ${_cml_rt_found}")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.fuzzer-x86_64.lib")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "CML_FUZZ: ${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.fuzzer-x86_64.lib not found; this LLVM install lacks libFuzzer")
        endif()
        set(_cml_fuzz_whole "/wholearchive:${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.fuzzer-x86_64.lib")
        if(EXISTS "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan-x86_64.lib" AND EXISTS "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan_cxx-x86_64.lib")
            # Older LLVM: the static runtime.
            set(_cml_fuzz_link_libs "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.fuzzer-x86_64.lib" "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan-x86_64.lib" "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan_cxx-x86_64.lib")
            set(_cml_fuzz_link_opts ${_cml_fuzz_whole} "/wholearchive:${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan-x86_64.lib"
                                    "/wholearchive:${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan_cxx-x86_64.lib" /debug /incremental:no)
        elseif(EXISTS "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.lib" AND EXISTS "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan_static_runtime_thunk-x86_64.lib")
            # LLVM 19 and later: the static CRT (/MT, what the project uses; libFuzzer is built for it) with the dynamic
            # runtime DLL behind a static thunk.
            set(_cml_fuzz_link_libs "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.fuzzer-x86_64.lib" "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.lib"
                                    "${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan_static_runtime_thunk-x86_64.lib")
            set(_cml_fuzz_link_opts ${_cml_fuzz_whole} "/wholearchive:${_cml_rt}/clang_rt.asan_static_runtime_thunk-x86_64.lib"
                                    /include:__asan_seh_interceptor /debug /incremental:no)
            foreach(_dir "${_cml_rt}" "${_cml_resource_dir}/../../../bin")
                if(EXISTS "${_dir}/clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll")
                    set(_cml_fuzz_asan_dll "${_dir}/clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll")
                    break()
                endif()
            endforeach()
            if(NOT _cml_fuzz_asan_dll)
                message(FATAL_ERROR "CML_FUZZ: clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll not found next to the runtime libraries or in the LLVM bin directory")
            endif()
        else()
            message(FATAL_ERROR "CML_FUZZ: no usable AddressSanitizer runtime in ${_cml_rt}")
        endif()
        message(STATUS "CML_FUZZ: ASan runtime DLL: ${_cml_fuzz_asan_dll}")
    endif()
    # The STL's container annotations need every object of a binary to agree; the readers do not need them.
    set(_cml_fuzz_san_flags -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link,address)
    if(MSVC)
        list(APPEND _cml_fuzz_san_flags /Oy-)  # frame pointers: readable stacks in crash reports
    else()
        list(APPEND _cml_fuzz_san_flags -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    endif()
    set(_cml_fuzz_defs _DISABLE_VECTOR_ANNOTATION _DISABLE_STRING_ANNOTATION)
    foreach(_lib IN LISTS CML_FUZZ_INSTRUMENTED)
        if(TARGET ${_lib})
            target_compile_options(${_lib} PRIVATE ${_cml_fuzz_san_flags})
            target_compile_definitions(${_lib} PRIVATE ${_cml_fuzz_defs})
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

foreach(_t IN LISTS CML_FUZZ_TARGETS)
    set(_exe cml_fuzz_${_t})
    if(CML_FUZZ)
        add_executable(${_exe} fuzz_${_t}.cpp)
        target_compile_options(${_exe} PRIVATE ${_cml_fuzz_san_flags})
        target_compile_definitions(${_exe} PRIVATE ${_cml_fuzz_defs})
        target_link_libraries(${_exe} PRIVATE ${CML_FUZZ_LIBS_${_t}} ${_cml_fuzz_link_libs})
        if(MSVC)
            target_link_options(${_exe} PRIVATE ${_cml_fuzz_link_opts})
            if(_cml_fuzz_asan_dll)
                add_custom_command(TARGET ${_exe} POST_BUILD
                    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${_cml_fuzz_asan_dll}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${_exe}>")
            endif()
        else()
            target_link_options(${_exe} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer,address)  # portable syntax-check hosts (Linux clang)
        endif()
    else()
        add_executable(${_exe} fuzz_${_t}.cpp replay_main.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(${_exe} PRIVATE ${CML_FUZZ_LIBS_${_t}})
    endif()
    target_include_directories(${_exe} PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
    cml_apply_warnings(${_exe})
    cml_target_core_style(${_exe})
    set_target_properties(${_exe} PROPERTIES FOLDER "tests/fuzz")

    # The exit code decides: replay_main.cpp returns non-zero for no input at all, libFuzzer for a crash. Under CML_FUZZ the
    # corpus files are passed one by one (-runs=0 replays them without mutating); an empty corpus is a configure-time error.
    if(CML_FUZZ)
        file(GLOB _cml_fuzz_seeds CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/${_t}/*")
        if(NOT _cml_fuzz_seeds)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "tests/fuzz/corpus/${_t} has no seed files")
        endif()
        add_test(NAME fuzz.replay.${_t} COMMAND ${_exe} -runs=0 ${_cml_fuzz_seeds})
    else()
        add_test(NAME fuzz.replay.${_t} COMMAND ${_exe} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/${_t}")
    endif()
    set_tests_properties(fuzz.replay.${_t} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 300)
endforeach()

# The pdb target maps files with the platform's API; off Windows it needs the thread library.
if(NOT MSVC)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(cml_fuzz_pdb PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
endif()

# gen_seeds: regenerates the generated part of the corpus from the unit tests' independent builders (not part of the
# default build; `cmake --build . --target cml_fuzz_gen_seeds`, then run it with the corpus directory).
add_executable(cml_fuzz_gen_seeds EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL gen_seeds.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cml_fuzz_gen_seeds PRIVATE cml_ipc cml_proc cml_util)
target_include_directories(cml_fuzz_gen_seeds PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../unit")
cml_apply_warnings(cml_fuzz_gen_seeds)
cml_target_exceptions_allowed(cml_fuzz_gen_seeds)
set_target_properties(cml_fuzz_gen_seeds PROPERTIES FOLDER "tests/fuzz")
